tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and main-pane ground: lists, the thread pane, docs.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar, table headers, ⌘K footer, a seat doc's side rail.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Things that sit on the ground: cards, menus, ⌘K, toasts, inputs.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Hover and active rows, secondary buttons, tool-call blocks, avatar fills.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: The selected row in a list (a 6% held tint). Text on it stays `text`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around surfaces. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Section rules and dividers that must read at a glance.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders (3:1 on bg and surface in both themes).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Titles, names, primary labels, on bg, sidebar, surface, raised and selected.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Running text in messages and docs, on bg, surface and raised.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata: cursors, times, handles, paths, counts, placeholders. On bg, sidebar, surface and raised (4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Vermilion. The one primary action per view, the inbox count, the mark's now-stop. Never a background for more than a control.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: held
tokens.usage: Something is waiting on you: held kinds (approval, decision), the held pill, unread dots, focus. As text on bg, surface, held-soft and selected.

tokens.name: held-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind held pills, the held chip, and the ground of an approval card.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: Agent identity: square avatars, the working state, arrival tints, spend bars. As text on bg, surface and agent-soft.

tokens.name: agent-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of an agent's square avatar.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Budget kind, alert thresholds. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Crimson. Failed, over budget, destructive outlines, field errors. Never a filled button, so it never reads as brand.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Review and proposal kinds, links inside docs.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done task state and passing checks. Always paired with a check glyph or the word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px offset. 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ada builds and fixes the product's backend.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Everything in the app shell at compact density: rows, messages, menus.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: You can make deploys automatic for Ada.

styles.name: mono-ui
styles.usage: Cursors, clock times, handles, paths, money.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Kinds, keyboard hints, sidebar group labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Tool calls, config blocks, code in messages.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row; sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card and menu padding; gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: List-row side padding; cell padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Thread-pane side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Doc page side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Agent avatars, kinds, labels, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, pills, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Surfaces: cards, menus, ⌘K, toasts, approval cards, tables.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: People's avatars and the new-events pill only.

size.note: Fixed sizes for the shell. Rows switch with density.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Row height at compact density (the default).

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Row height at comfortable density.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons (dialogs, empty states).

tokens.name: avatar-xs
tokens.usage: Avatars inline in rows and facts.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatars in the sidebar and lists.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatars beside messages.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Seat and person headers.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Lucide icons, 1.5px stroke.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The sidebar at compact density.

tokens.name: list-width
tokens.usage: The list column beside the thread pane.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only for things that float above the page: menus, ⌘K, toasts, tooltips, the new-events pill.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Opacity and color on open and close.

tokens.name: duration-arrive
tokens.usage: The tint on a newly arrived agent event.
